summary: JSON pretty printing is implemented per the spec: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py, the JSON renderable with a __main__ CLI in rich/json.py, six json.* default styles, Console.print_json, package-level rich.print_json, docs (console.rst "Printing JSON" section, reference/json.rst, reference.rst toctree), a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry, and two new tests (test_print_json, test_rich_print_json).
